summary: Regression tests for N+1 projection fix (appointments & invoices), auth.py/users.py/roles.py refactor, DELETE /api/notes/{id}, and account state. All 15 backend pytest tests PASS. UI verified: patient names resolve correctly on Appointments and Invoices pages; delete-note buttons render (215 found on Progress Notes page). Two 'Unknown' appointments observed are the expected pre-existing orphan appointments.

minor.issue: No invoice-delete endpoint exists. Test-created invoices (TEST_*) cannot be cleaned up via API — a few TEST_ invoices remain in DB from this run. Suggest adding admin-only DELETE for cleanup.

ui_bugs.issue: Login page still hardcodes demo accounts (doctor@vpp.com, nurse@vpp.com, reception@vpp.com, biller@vpp.com) as clickable quick-login cards. These accounts were ERASED (SEED_DEMO_USERS=false). Clicking them results in 401. Remove or hide this section since demo accounts no longer exist.
ui_bugs.selector: login page 'Cuentas de prueba' / 'Test accounts' section

action_items: Hide/remove the demo test-account panel on the login page (or make it dynamic based on SEED_DEMO_USERS).
Optional: add DELETE /api/invoices/{id} (admin) to allow test data cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: Projection fix in appointments.py and billing.py is correct — only id/first_name/last_name are fetched, still returned as a dict keyed by id for O(1) lookup. Good pattern; consider extracting the `patients` dict builder into a shared helper in core/db.py for reuse (DRY).
notes.py delete correctly checks author or admin; audited via log_audit. LGTM.
auth.py/users.py/roles.py split is clean; all URLs preserved and admin gates intact.
billing.py list_invoices projection excludes ssn/policy_number — good defence-in-depth.
seed_data_creation: Tests create throwaway patients, appointments, invoices, users, and notes with TEST_ prefix and clean them up (except invoices — no delete endpoint). A few TEST_ invoices remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_24.py — reuse for future N+1/auth-refactor checks. Note: emails ending in .local are rejected by pydantic email validator; use @example.com for test users. There are 2 legitimately orphan appointments returning 'Unknown' patient_name — not a bug.
